reason: I have an interview in a few weeks and I already practise every evening alone, so a daily plan with a countdown and a score for each sound fits how I work. I'd use the 7-day trial, and if it actually shows me progress I'd pay one month of $4.99 instead of the year.
objection: It only checks pronunciation, and in an IT interview they care more about what I say and my grammar than about my accent. Paying in dollars through the App Store also feels like a lot in soms for something that covers only part of the problem.
would_change_my_mind: If the trial week doesn't show my scores going up, or the Russian explanations turn out generic, I'd cancel before paying.
